question: What is the smallest durable observation model that allows deterministic longitudinal evaluation of actual-vs-shadow routing without turning counterfactual estimates into claimed empirical savings?

options_evaluated.name: Append every event directly into repository evidence/*.jsonl
options_evaluated.rationale: Runtime telemetry continuously dirties git working tree, creates unbounded repository bloat, and couples runtime speed to repository IO.

options_evaluated.name: Runtime append-only tamper-evident journal under XDG state + bounded deterministic evidence exports
options_evaluated.rationale: Keeps git clean during live operation; uses simple append-only JSONL under $XDG_STATE_HOME/kad-pi/shadow-observatory/ with SHA-256 hash chaining for tamper evidence, malformed-tail recovery, bounded retention, and deterministic export snapshots into evidence/.

options_evaluated.name: New SQLite/database subsystem
options_evaluated.rationale: Unnecessary dependency overhead, binary lock files, schema migration complexity, and non-text diffs for a straightforward sequential stream of observation events.

options_evaluated.name: External analytics or LLM-based evaluator
options_evaluated.rationale: Violates 'deterministic authority > probabilistic inference', wastes tokens/budget on telemetry analysis, and risks non-reproducible evaluation.

invariants_enforced: No git dirtying during runtime session turns
Append-only tamper-evident hash chaining (previous_hash + canonical_event -> event_hash)
Strict epistemic separation (OBSERVED vs COUNTERFACTUAL vs ESTIMATED_COUNTERFACTUAL)
Zero secret, prompt, or completion persistence
